ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)
module_role: Packet-based serial display interface stack inside a SoC, layered as Application → Low Level Protocol → Lane Management → PHY (per DSI §4.1). Provides the wire-level transport for both Video Mode pixel streaming (DPI-2-like) and Command Mode command/parameter delivery (DBI-2-like + DCS).

integration_overview.wire_directions: Clock Lane host → peripheral only; Data Lane 0 bidirectional in LP for Command Mode; additional Data Lanes 1..3 host → peripheral only.
integration_overview.no_chip_select: No CS line; point-to-point pair with VC[1:0] for up to 4 logical channels.
integration_overview.no_addressing_at_dsi_layer: DSI Protocol Layer does not address a register file; DCS commands carry vendor/standardized command codes inside DSI 0x05/0x15/0x06/0x39 packets.
integration_overview.controller_choices: Host is always Clock Lane driver and dominant HS payload source. Peripheral drives LP only on Data Lane 0.
integration_overview.handshake: BTA (Bus Turn-Around) provides explicit ownership handover for reverse-direction Acknowledge / Error Report / Read Response / TE.

interface_categories: Host D-PHY transmitter on Clock Lane + Data Lanes 0..N-1.
Peripheral D-PHY receiver on Clock Lane + Data Lanes.
DSI Protocol Layer — header builder + ECC; payload builder + CRC; EoTp generator/detector; BTA controller; Error Register accumulator.
Application interface — Pixel-to-Byte Packing block; Command Generation/Interpretation block; Tearing Effect controller.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Point-to-point — host ↔ one peripheral per physical DSI Link (normative scope).
default_signal_values_when_omitted: All Lanes idle LP-11 (Stop state) between transmissions; peripheral in LP-RX until host begins HS Entry; peripheral's Maximum Return Packet Size defaults to 1 byte at power-on / reset.
soc_dependent_items: Operating mode: Command Mode and/or Video Mode.
Video Mode packet sequence: Non-Burst Sync Pulses / Non-Burst Sync Events / Burst.
Pixel format: 16-bpp RGB565 / 18-bpp RGB666 Packed / 18-bpp RGB666 Loosely Packed / 24-bpp RGB888.
Bidirectional support on Data Lane 0 (mandatory in Command Mode, optional in Video Mode).
PLL providing Clock Lane DDR frequency on host; CDR on peripheral.
Vendor sideband (backlight, panel-reset GPIOs) outside DSI scope.

pcb_integration_constraints.max_trace_length_cm: ≤ 30 (depends on data rate; shorter at 1.5+ Gbps).
pcb_integration_constraints.AC_coupling: NOT used — D-PHY is DC-coupled differential.

low_power_modes.Non_Continuous_Clock: Clock Lane returns to LP-11 between bursts.
low_power_modes.BLLP_LP_substitution: Video Mode HBP/HFP intervals can substitute LP for Blanking Packets.

typical_use_cases: Video Mode handheld display without on-panel frame buffer.
Command Mode display with on-panel frame buffer.

responsibilities: Pixel-to-Byte Packing Formats (RGB565/RGB666 Packed/RGB666 Loosely Packed/RGB888)

pcb_integration_constraints_inherited_fr.max_trace_length_cm: ≤ 30 cm at sub-Gbps rates; shorter at higher rates (per D-PHY).
pcb_integration_constraints_inherited_fr.AC_coupling: NOT used — D-PHY is DC-coupled differential.
